scenes.line1: How do you monitor your app?
scenes.say: How do you monitor your ASP.NET Core app? What makes it observable and ready for production?

scenes.label: Checks
scenes.sub: Use built-in health checks to expose app status at a /health endpoint.
scenes.say: ASP.NET Core has built-in health checks. Expose app status at a slash health endpoint for easy monitoring.
Add structured logging with ILogger. Log important events for diagnostics and monitoring.

rows.b: Trace requests and enrich with metadata

scenes.say: To add distributed tracing, install OpenTelemetry, configure tracing, and instrument your app with metadata.

scenes.question: How do you expose a health check endpoint?
scenes.right: Register health checks and map them with MapHealthChecks to a slash health endpoint.
scenes.say: Interview trap: How do you expose a health check endpoint? Don't just add health checks—map them to a slash health endpoint.
